home.description: InkyBay is a Shopify product customizer: shoppers design text, images and artwork live on any product, and your team gets print-ready orders.

social.image_alt: InkyBay, the product customizer for Shopify
social.headline: Sell personalized products with a live design editor

links._note: Every outside URL the site links to; templates and JSON use {{LINK:<key>}}

footer._note: Footer social icons and newsletter (build.py {{FOOT_SOCIAL}} and {{FOOT_NEWS}}); icons are src/assets/social/<key>.svg

languages._note: Footer language switcher (build.py {{LANG_SWITCH}}). Pages are written in English; any other language is machine-translated in the browser by Google Translate, whose script loads only after a visitor picks one. code = Google Translate language code.
